# Subread (featureCounts)

`nf-core/subread`

featureCounts counts the mapped reads that fall on genomic features such as genes and exons, turning RNA-seq or DNA-seq alignments into a table of counts per feature.

Homepage: http://bioinf.wehi.edu.au/featureCounts/

Cite: doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btt656
